{{short description|none}}
{{see also|Glossary of graph theory terms}}
This sortable list points to the articles describing various individual (finite) [[Graph (discrete mathematics)|graphs]].<ref>R. Diestel, ''Graph Theory'', p.8.  3rd Edition, Springer-Verlag, 2005</ref> The columns 'vertices', 'edges', '[[Distance (graph theory)#Related concepts|radius]]', '[[Graph diameter|diameter]]', '[[Girth (graph theory)|girth]]', 'P' (whether the graph is [[Planar graph|planar]]), χ ([[chromatic number]]) and χ' ([[chromatic index]]) are also sortable, allowing searching for a parameter. In the planarity column, T indicates that the graph is planar and F indicates that the graph is not planar.

{{Commons category|Graphs by number of vertices}}
See also [[Graph theory]] for the general theory, as well as [[Gallery of named graphs]] for a list with illustrations. 
 {{clear}}
